backend/main.mo: Main backend canister defining story, comment, review, user profile types and state, with access control, submission, profile management, and pending-story workflow.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting old actor state to new format by mapping previous story list into pendingStories.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing feature IDs, related frontend files, components, and requirement IDs for admin workflows and article removal.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of key frontend files covering routing, UI components, hooks, styling, and pages.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide explaining canister roles, usage of frontend canister ID, and basic deployment steps.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based stylesheet defining color tokens, light/dark themes, and base styling rules.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React app root and main script with site title configured.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React router configuration defining routes for pages such as home, stories, submissions, admin, articles, and profile.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedStat: UI component showing an access-denied message with a redirect button for unauthorized users.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Header component with brand title, navigation links, and conditional My Submissions entry for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Layout wrapper providing header, main content area, and footer with navigation and contact info.
Comment form that submits a new comment via useAddComment and handles pending/error states.
frontend/src/components/CommentThread.ts: Displays comments for a story using useGetComments with loading, empty, and formatted timestamp states.
frontend/src/components/CommentThreadDis: Shows comments for a story from aggregated discussions via useGetAllDiscussions with loading and empty handling.
frontend/src/components/FeedDiagnosticsP: Diagnostics panel that displays canister IDs and URLs with copy-to-clipboard and troubleshooting helpers.
frontend/src/components/ReviewComposer.t: Form to submit a star rating and optional review using useAddReview, with validation and pending states.
frontend/src/components/ReviewThread.tsx: Renders a list of reviews for a story from useGetAllDiscussions, showing ratings, comments, and timestamps.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to user identity, refreshing dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdmin.ts: Admin-focused hooks for checking admin status and managing stories, including publishing, creating, and deleting.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendAvailabilit: Provides a hook that checks backend heartbeat status and reports reachability states using react-query.
frontend/src/hooks/useDiscussions.ts: Defines hooks for fetching discussions and adding reviews, with react-query caching and invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity context and provider for authentication, exposing login, logout, and identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useStories.ts: Contains hooks for fetching stories, comments, submissions, and submitting new content with retry logic and cache updates.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind-based global styles, color themes, typography, and UI state utilities for light and dark mode.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider before rendering the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders a styled About page with author info, platform purpose, and contact details.
frontend/src/pages/AdminModerationPage.t: Provides an admin interface for moderating stories, creating articles, and managing published content.
frontend/src/pages/ArticleDetailPage.tsx: Displays a single published article with author info, date, full content, and a comments section, handling loading and error states.
frontend/src/pages/ArticlesPage.tsx: Shows a list of published articles with metadata, includes loading and error handling, and links to individual article pages.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Provides contact details for the author including email, social links, and book info.
frontend/src/pages/DiscussionsPage.tsx: Aggregates discussions across topics, allowing users to view and switch between comments and reviews for each story.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Renders the main story feed with backend availability diagnostics, error messaging, and story previews.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page highlighting the platform’s purpose with calls to read or share stories and feature highlights.
frontend/src/pages/MySubmissionsPage.tsx: Displays the user's story submissions with login checks, loading states, error handling, and formatted submission list.
frontend/src/pages/StoryDetailPage.tsx: Fetches and shows a published story with metadata and comments, handling loading and error states.
frontend/src/pages/SubmitStoryPage.tsx: Provides a form for authenticated users to submit new stories, including validation, anonymous mode, and success flow.
frontend/src/pages/TroubleshootingPage.t: Explains canister ID resolution issues and displays detected canister info with copy-to-clipboard utilities.
frontend/src/utils/canisterUrls.ts: Generates canister IDs and URLs by checking hostname or environment variables for troubleshooting and compatibility.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters with session persistence and hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration enabling dark mode, custom colors, typography, container queries, animations, and extended theme settings.
project_state.json: Defines project state for an article app, listing existing features, pending requests, and metadata about admin approval and article removal workflows.
